description: HydroSim v4.8.0: probabilistic water-security screening for data-centre development in a drought-prone region HydroSim v4.8.0: triagem probabilística de segurança hídrica para implantação de data centers em região sujeit is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Thiago François Queiros Lefebure (Independent researcher). Reproducible analysis code, input data, generated artifacts and regression test suite for a probabilistic water-security screening framework applied to data-centre development in the Pecém industrial cluster, Ceará, Brazil. The framework operates in three layers. First, Monte Carlo simulation of data-centre water demand across four heat-rejection configurations, driven by a 26-year observed local climate pool. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
